newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Denmark to grant Bangladesh 167 million crowns.
newsitem.headline: Denmark to grant Bangladesh 167 million crowns.

text.p: Denmark will grant Bangladesh 167 million crowns to finace the country's development projects in calendar 1997, finance ministry officials said on Tuesday.

They said the two countries signed "agreed minutes" on the assistance following a three-day annual consultations here on Tuesday. Bangladesh is expected to receive a total of 1.3 billion crowns in Danish aid during 1997-2001 period as envisaged in the agreement, they added.
The officials said the Danish help was mostly directed to rural development, building of infrastructure, agriculture, healthcare and transportation.
